title: Extremely confusing instructions, definitely used "fuzzy logic" in the manual!
text:
Extremely confusing instructions, definitely used "fuzzy logic" in the manual!. Very confusing instructions on how to use and how much water to put in this thing... I ended up guessing and by the time I spent a good 20 minutes trying to decode the manual and then washing the pot in it so I could use it- I put the rice and what I guess to be the correct amount of water in and go to hit the white rice option to see 50 minutes!! We wanted supper in like 20... So I hit the quick option and hoped for the best. I didn't hear it start and since it runs in 5 min intervals on the timer- I didn't know WHAT was going on. But I had faith it was working as I could feel it heating up from putting my hand on it. About 25 min later I had usable rice! It was slightly firm in texture, like that weird microwave pouch rice. But it was still very edible and much better than the horrible rice I get if I try to cook it in a microwave or pan cook it myself.

I don't understand the measurements in the pot and the ones on the cup and where I'm supposed to put the water... My old Oster brand rice cooker was $15 and sooo much easier to use! I honestly might rehome this to someone who has more patience with crazy appliances but I miss my Oster one where I can just push the lever down and start it. The rice was always stuck to the bottom layer a bit but other than that it always came out perfect and in much less than 50 minutes!

product_metadata.title: Toshiba Small Rice Cooker 3 Cup Uncooked – LCD Display with 8 Cooking Functions, Fuzzy Logic Technology, 24-Hr Delay Timer and Auto Keep Warm, Non-Stick Inner Pot, White
features: Multi-Function - This mini rice cooker cooks a variety of dishes, not just rice. Features 8 cooking functions, including White Rice, Quick Cook, Brown Rice, Mixed Grain, Slow Cook, Porridge, Cake, and Egg. This sticky rice cooker also makes soups, stews, oatmeal, cakes, and more. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned chef, this Toshiba rice cooker 6 cup Cooked offers great versatility and convenience

Highly Versatile – This small rice cooker can make a variety of rice types, including brown rice, jasmine rice, sushi rice, white rice, basmati rice, and wild rice, as well as grains like oatmeal, quinoa, mixed grain, and more. This 3 cup rice cooker is perfect for families or individuals who want to cook multiple servings of rice, while still being compact enough to fit comfortably on your kitchen counter

Fuzzy Logic Rice Cooker - Allows this Japanese rice cooker to sense the moisture content of the rice and adjust the temperature and cooking time accordingly. Results in perfectly cooked fluffy rice every time, without the need for manual adjustments or guesswork. It also helps the rice maker cooker cook other types of grains and dishes to perfection by adjusting the cooking parameters to the specific needs of the food

Easy To Use- This electric rice cooker 3 cup is designed with intuitive control panel features a large LCD display for quick and effortless programming. Keep Warm/Reheat function keeps your rice warm and delicious for hours, the Delay Timer allows you to schedule your cooking up to 24 hours in advance. Accessories included: measuring cup, spatula, and soup ladle.

Easy To Clean-Inner pot with non-stick coating and not recommended dishwasher safe and should be washed with mild soap and soft cloth. The steam valve located on the top of the lid can be easily removed for cleaning. Steam vent cap is also removable for easy cleaning

Safe Hassle-Free Cooking – Detachable power cord prevents accidents caused by entanglement. Lid locks firmly in place during cooking to prevent spills. Thermal fuse prevents overheating. Steam vent cap prevents hot steam from escaping during cooking. Automatic shut-off turns off heating element when cooking is done. Compared to other high-end rice cookers, this Toshiba model is a great option for those on a budget who still want a quality sushi rice cooker
WARRANTY FROM Toshiba - Toshiba will provide 1 year manufacturer warranty together with your purchase. If you have any questions, please refer to customer service information in the user manual.
